title: PreSO: Privileged Representation Isolation for On-Policy Self-Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.14001v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) uses a self-teacher conditioned on privileged information to turn the sparse outcome signal of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) into dense token-level supervision. Yet the teacher's advantage may depend on information unavailable to the student at inference, raising a central question: which privileged changes are worth distilling? We use cross-problem recurrence as an empirical cue for potentially reusable guidance. Comparing the representation shifts induced by full solutions and compact hints, we find that hint-induced shifts are more concentrated and directionally consistent across problems, and yield more sustained downstream gains despite revealing less information. Motivated by this association, we propose Privileged Representation Isolation for On-Policy Self-Distillation (PreSO). translated_title: PreSO：面向在线策略自蒸馏的特权表征隔离
translated_abstract: 在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）利用以特权信息为条件的自我教师模型，将可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的稀疏结果信号转化为密集的词元级监督。然而，教师模型的优势可能依赖于学生在推理时无法获取的信息，由此引出一个核心问题：哪些特权变化值得蒸馏？我们采用跨问题复现性作为判断指导是否潜在可复用的经验性线索。通过比较完整解答与紧凑提示所引起的表征偏移，我们发现提示引起的偏移更加集中，且在不同问题间方向上更加一致，尽管泄露的信息更少，却能带来更持久的下游收益。受这一关联的启发，我们提出了面向在线策略自蒸馏的特权表征隔离方法。在源头端，PreSO 使用紧凑提示来限制进入提示的解答特定细节……（摘要内容不完整，原文在此处被截断）
tldr: PreSO 通过利用紧凑提示与跨问题复现性来隔离特权信息中可复用的指导成分，将 RLVR 的稀疏信号转化为更持久有效的密集词元级监督，从而改进在线策略自蒸馏。
en_tdlr: PreSO improves on-policy self-distillation by isolating reusable privileged guidance through compact hints and cross-problem recurrence, converting sparse RLVR signals into more sustained and effective dense token-level supervision.
